review.notes: Gate: reviewer run fails only depcheck NOT IN ORDER (placement of a new roadmap, not a finding); worker gate all checks 0; depcheck against the candidate order 236 roadmaps, 2266 edges, 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with 4 sorry warnings only; #check @ of all 6 declarations matches the README; no declaration closes in one tactic. Seeded sample: 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.6 and 1.4 verified against the Loday-Quillen 1984 GDZ scan (pp. 566, 581-587, read as images); 4.1, 4.2, 4.5 against Cuntz-Quillen 1995a (AMS free archive); 4.3, 4.4 against Cuntz-Quillen 1995b; 1.3 against Dwyer-Hopkins-Kan p. 287; 5.3 against Cortinas arXiv. Not verifiable: 1.2 (Connes CRAS, Loday book), 4.6 (CQ 1993/1997), 5.2 (Wodzicki), 5.4 and 5.5 (Marin JPAA, Gonzalez-Ferez-Marin J. Algebra, Elsevier paywall at the service). Blocking: R01 P1, the claim that an I-adic completion of a quasi-free algebra is quasi-free is false (Q[[x]]); R02 P2, the Hopf structure of 2.1 drops LQ's characteristic-zero hypothesis; R03 P2, nil-invariance of HP over Q is already owned by RefinedTraceMethods 4.9 and 4.18. Also found: uncited pinned Tau Ceti cyclic cohomology and universal forms, and the false claim that SmoothRepresentationsOfLocalGroups cites 5.4.
